snippet.title: Virtua Golf / Dynamic Golf
snippet.description: Virtua Golf, known as Dynamic Golf (ダイナミックゴルフ) in Japan, is a Sega NAOMI golf simulator. A Sega Dreamcast version was planned, but was later removed from Sega's release schedules without warning. No other home version of the game has ever been released.
